dct_title_s: Damage assessment over Ras Rajel, Tabarka delegation, Jendouba Governorate, Tunisia as of 27 July 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FR20230725TUN** This map illustrate satellite-detected burnt areas and affected structures over Ras Rajel, Tabarka delegation, Jendouba Governorate, Tunisia as observed from a Sentinel-2 image aquired on the 27 July 2023 10:20 UTC and a Pleiades image acquired on 27 July 2023 at 10:28 UTC. Within the the analyzed area of about 100 km², about 3 % of land appears to be burned. In total 83 buildings are affected. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
